overarching_objective: The student can describe their daily study routine, identify basic learning tools, and discuss their English learning habits and goals with their tutor.
final_task: A role-play interview where the student acts as a dedicated learner presenting their complete weekly study schedule, the tools they use, their challenges, and their goals to the tutor, who acts as an academic advisor.

lessons.objective: Identify and name basic objects used for studying English.
lessons.topic: Introducing the basic items needed for an online English class.
lessons.lesson_task: The tutor will ask the student what items they have on their desk. The student will verbally identify and show their study tools using the target phrases.

lessons.objective: State basic actions related to learning a language.
lessons.topic: Discussing which English skills the student wants to focus on.
lessons.lesson_task: The tutor will ask the student about their preferences. The student will verbally state which English actions they like to do and which ones they need to practice more.

lessons.objective: Name the days of the week and state when classes happen.
lessons.topic: Planning the week and deciding when to practice English.
lessons.lesson_task: The tutor will ask about the student's week. The student will verbally describe which days they have class and which days they rest, recycling the word 'practice'.

lessons.objective: Specify the time of day when study activities occur.
lessons.topic: Organizing daily routines around work and family.
lessons.lesson_task: The tutor will ask when the student prefers to study. The student will verbally explain what time of day they do different activities, recycling the words 'read' and 'listen'.

lessons.objective: State exact times for starting and finishing study sessions.
lessons.topic: Setting a specific schedule for English classes.
lessons.lesson_task: The tutor will role-play setting up a new class schedule. The student must verbally confirm exactly what time they start and finish their work and study, recycling the words 'morning' and 'laptop'.

lessons.objective: Express how often different study habits are performed.
lessons.topic: Evaluating good and bad habits in learning.
lessons.lesson_task: The tutor will ask a series of 'How often' questions. The student will verbally answer using frequency words to describe their habits, recycling the words 'weekend' and 'write'.

lessons.objective: Describe the location and environment where studying takes place.
lessons.topic: Finding the best place to focus on English lessons.
lessons.lesson_task: The student will verbally describe their current study space to the tutor, explaining why it is a good place to learn, recycling the words 'evening' and 'always'.

lessons.objective: Express basic feelings and difficulties related to studying.
lessons.topic: Communicating with the tutor when balancing a busy work life and classes.
lessons.lesson_task: A role-play where the tutor gives the student a large assignment. The student must verbally explain that they are busy or tired, and ask the tutor for help, recycling the words 'night' and 'speak'.

lessons.objective: State basic reasons and motivations for learning English.
lessons.topic: Discussing the future benefits of improving English skills.
lessons.lesson_task: The tutor will ask the student why they are taking classes. The student will verbally share their main reasons and goals, recycling the words 'practice' and 'difficult'.

lessons.objective: Summarize a weekly study routine, including tools, times, challenges, and goals.
lessons.topic: Presenting the final learning routine to the tutor.
lessons.lesson_task: This task executes the final_task. The tutor will act as an academic advisor and ask the student to present their full study plan. The student will verbally describe their schedule, the tools they use, their challenges, and their goals. The tutor MUST prompt the student to use vocabulary and phrases from L1-L9, asking follow-up questions such as 'What days do you study? What is difficult for you? What is your goal?' to ensure a complete review.
